description: Defect classification and JIRA creation rules. Defect Agent reads this to categorize failures and decide actions.

productDefect.criteria: Test logic is correct but application behaves unexpectedly
productDefect.priority: Derived from test priority (P1 test failure = P1 bug)

testScriptError.criteria: Test script has a problem (selector stale, logic error, flaky assertion)

environmentIssue.criteria: Infrastructure failure (timeout, DNS, 503, VPN, tunnel down)
environmentIssue.action: Log in report only. Flag for retest.

deduplication.strategy: Search JIRA by TC-ID in summary before creating
deduplication.ifDuplicateFound: Add comment to existing issue instead of creating new

jiraDefaults.projectKey: DERIVED at runtime from the story key (storyKey.split('-')[0], e.g. BREW-94 -> BREW). NOT a field in pipeline-config.json.

severity.P3: Minor issue, cosmetic or edge case
